title: Real Activity Forecasts Using Loan Portfolio Information

scopes.description: The complete supplemental empirical workflow described in the assigned internet appendix: capital-incentive analysis (Table 1A), annual GSP forecasting (Table 2A), single-state-bank robustness (Table 3A), additional economic-condition specifications (Table 4A), and state-recession forecasts (Table 5A). The appendix has no executable code or data.

requirements.description: Author-compatible analysis data or the author-specified source inputs needed to regenerate supplemental regression Tables 1A–5A. These results require empirical observations, but the assigned appendix contains no dataset or input manifest and defers many variable definitions to the absent main-paper Appendix A. Exact file products, fields, history, identifiers, and preparation steps are therefore unresolved.

issues.description: The supplied variant reports five supplementary empirical regression outputs (Tables 1A–5A) but contains no author analysis or data-preparation program and no runnable entry point. The appendix is results documentation only.

The appendix describes the supplemental estimands and some transformations but does not provide the main paper’s variable definitions, source-to-variable mapping, analysis-data filenames, population/history, or the code and producer order for the five tables. The appendix’s references to BEA, call-report capital, deposits, and other study variables are contextual leads only; they do not establish separate live raw-source requirements. No analysis-only bypass is supported because no compatible dataset or analysis entry point is supplied.
